site.arbeidsflyt.evidens_tekst: Whatever cannot be done automatically is collected in one queue with reasoning and history. Nothing disappears quietly.
site.arbeidsflyt.policy_tekst: The action is measured against your policy BEFORE it is carried out. If a condition is missing — an attestation, a limit, an approval — it is not done.
site.arbeidsflyt.styring_tekst: An event arrives — an invoice, a deadline, an enquiry. The agent works out what it concerns and what, if anything, needs doing.
site.argument.kostnad_tekst: Put the agent on one area first, with tight limits. Widen it once you see what it actually does. The authority can be narrowed again at any time.
site.argument.plattform_tekst: Decisions, exceptions, policy management and user access live in the same surface. No hunting through four systems to find out why something was done — or wasn't.
site.argument.plattform_tittel: One place for operations, policy and exceptions
site.argument.presisjon_tekst: The authority is a policy you manage yourself: amount limits, which actions require attestation, and who may approve. Changes take four eyes, and no button overrides them.
site.argument.presisjon_tittel: You decide what the agent may do
site.cta.tittel: Start with one area. Expand when you are ready.
site.fase.autopiloter.tekst: End-to-end processes such as purchasing, campaigns, telephony and fraud watch.
site.fase.fundament.tekst: Platform, security, audit, exceptions, identity and the first operational flows.
site.fase.global.tekst: Localisation, compliance, continuity and portfolio control across markets.
site.fase.operasjoner.tekst: Finance, customer follow-up, reporting and standardised work processes.
site.footer.tekst: AI business agent with control before action.
site.hero.punkt.fullmakt: You write the authority. The agent can never step outside it.
site.hero.punkt.spor: Every decision is traceable afterwards, with its reasoning.
site.hero.punkt.stopp: Anything outside the limits stops and lands in one queue with you.
site.hero.tekst: Every area below is live with customers today.
site.hero.tekst_bygges: The control layer runs today — policy engine, audit log, exception queue and policy administration with four eyes. The first module doing real work — automatic WCAG checks of websites you have confirmed that you control — has passed the acceptance gate and is in operation. The remaining areas are specified and under construction.
site.hero.tekst_delvis: The areas below marked “Available” are live with customers today; the rest are being built.
site.hero.tilbud: Disponit is being built to handle the routine work of your business: payments within approval limits, invoicing and reminders, reconciliation and settlement, deadlines and renewals, follow-up with customers and suppliers, recurring reports, automatic checks against regulations, and key figures computed from actual decisions. The principle is fixed: every action is measured against your policy before it happens — if it is within bounds it is carried out; if not, it is stopped and placed with you.
site.hero.tittel: Disponit does the work in your business — within authority you set yourself.
site.home.flyt.handling.tekst: A task, deadline or check needs handling.
site.home.flyt.label: An action in Disponit
site.home.flyt.policy.tekst: Authority, limits and attestations are checked first.
site.home.flyt.spor.tekst: The decision is tied to its policy version and audit trail.
site.home.flyt.utfall.tekst: Nothing is guessed when a condition is missing.
site.home.ingress: Disponit carries out day-to-day work within the authority you set. What is inside the limits gets done. What is outside stops with a reason for you.
site.home.tittel: Let routine work move. Keep control.
site.katalog_note: Planned product scope: {antall} modules across four phases. What is available today is listed under “What you get”.
site.katalog_tittel: One agent platform, eleven business areas

site.login.admin_tittel: Sign in as owner or operations

site.modul.m1.tekst: Defines what the agents are actually allowed to do.
site.modul.m16.tekst: Key figures computed from actual decisions — a pure read surface, nothing smoothed or projected.
site.modul.m2.tekst: Makes every automated action traceable and reviewable.
site.modul.m21.tekst: An obligations register with alerts well ahead of every deadline. Each obligation has an owner, and a deadline is closed by a receipt or a written status — never by time simply passing it.
site.modul.m3.tekst: Measures data quality instead of assuming it: empty fields, format deviations and duplicate keys are profiled and reported with numbers. v1 corrects nothing and blocks no order — it makes quality visible, so acting on it becomes a deliberate decision.
site.modul.m31.tekst: Golden-set evaluation of model-based modules: every model switch is measured against a hash-pinned example set, and the release gate only admits a passing run against the current requirement.
site.modul.m35.tekst: Keeps preparedness measured rather than assumed: a service map with recovery targets, confirmed emergency contacts, an append-only incident log — and an exercise that reads the actual backup evidence and reports red when it is missing.
site.modul.m37.tekst: Collects everything stopped by policy into one controlled queue.
site.modul.m38.tekst: Distributes work, capacity and model choice per tenant and flow.
site.modul.m4.tekst: The house's retention ledger: every store names its deadline and its reaper, holdings are measured, and a store without a written verdict becomes a finding. The module deletes nothing — it makes the difference between “deliberately without a deadline” and “forgotten” readable.
site.modul.m5.tekst: Versioned document templates with required fields and locked clauses. Facts come from source fields and are never invented: a field without backing in the input is marked missing rather than filled with something that merely looks right.
site.modul.m56.tekst: Checks websites you have confirmed that you control, and stores the report as evidence.
site.modul.m57.tekst: Reads and ranks up to 5,000 applications blind against the role's requirements — a human decides who moves on, and nothing is sent without a signature.
site.modul.m6.tekst: Reads and prioritises your inbox — classification, drafts and follow-up suggestions; nothing is sent automatically.
site.modul.m8.tekst: Lets candidates pick their own interview time — no login, no email back-and-forth.
site.modul.m9.tekst: Company terms with owner, source and validity date — and full-text search across them. A term without a source cannot be registered, and a term past its validity date becomes a finding rather than a quietly stale truth.
site.moduler_note: These statuses are operational, not decorative.
site.moduler_tittel: Modules that move the platform forward
site.nav.logo: Disponit – go to the home page
site.problem.etterpa_tekst: The mistake surfaces at month-end, not as it happens. By then it has already been carried out.
site.problem.manuelt_tekst: Limits and authority live in heads, spreadsheets and threads. Nobody can say for certain what applies today.
site.problem.spredt_tekst: Ask why a payment went through, and you assemble the answer from accounting, the bank, email and a note.
site.problem.spredt_tittel: The answer sits in four systems
site.problem_tekst: Most tools can perform the task. What they cannot do is show that it was allowed — and stop when it wasn't.
site.security.tekst: Authority, attestation and audit trails are part of the workflow itself. When a condition is missing, the action stops and explains what needs to be resolved.
site.security.tittel: The agent never gets more authority than you give it.
site.sok.label: Search services
site.sok.tom: No services match your search. Try another term.
site.svar.data_sv: With us, encrypted, with access control per business: no sharing between customers, no use for anything you have not agreed to. Production gets its own machine, set up before the first customer. Today only staging exists, and it holds synthetic test data — never customer data.
site.svar.feil_sp: What happens when it is unsure?
site.svar.feil_sv: It stops. Doubt is treated as refusal, not as a probable yes, and the case goes to the queue with what was missing.
site.svar.hvem_sv: Businesses that already have rules for who may approve what, and want the system to enforce them rather than hope for them.
site.svar.kontroll_sp: What stops the agent doing something stupid?
site.svar.kontroll_sv: Your policy, enforced before the action. If a condition is missing, the action is not carried out — it stops and comes to you. A person can release that case, but only what your policy has made approvable in advance: the role the policy requires, the ceiling the policy sets, and exactly the condition that stopped it. Everything else stands, and the approval is logged. No button grants itself authority.
site.svar.start_sv: With one area and tight limits. You see what the agent actually does before you widen its authority — and it can be narrowed again at any time.
site.svar_tittel: What you'd ask in a meeting
site.tilbud.fullmakt.tekst: You set the limits: amounts, which actions need attestation, and who may approve. The agent measures every action against them before acting.
site.tilbud.kapasitet.tekst: Work distribution and model choice per area, so volume never comes at the cost of control.
site.tilbud.spor.tekst: Every decision is traceable afterwards: what was done, why, against which policy version. Without digging through logs.
site.tilbud.unntak.tekst: Anything that cannot be done inside the limits lands in one queue with its reasoning — not in an inbox. You decide, the agent completes.
site.tilbud_note: Start with one area. Widen it once you see what it does.
site.tilbud_tittel: An agent that does the work, inside your limits
site.tjenester.tekst: Explore the platform by business area or search for the task you want to solve. Availability is shown on the home page – this catalogue shows the full product scope.

Rollback is not possible for “{policy}”: the identity does not meet the requirements for new drafts (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at least three characters). The history can be read, but a new draft must be created on a policy with a valid ID.

ui.historikk.rullbakk_tekst: This creates a draft from version {n}. It must be validated and approved before it takes effect: by two people if the change expands authority, otherwise by one person who did not write the draft. Nothing changes now.

ui.policy.flere_aktive: Several policies are active at the same time for this workspace. This is a fault state: the enforced policy cannot be shown until it is resolved. If one of them was created by mistake, it can be deleted here as long as it has never governed a decision.
ui.policy.korrupt_aktiv: The active policy cannot be read — its content is not valid, so the policy cannot be shown. This is a fault state: enforcement rejects decisions for as long as it stands. If the policy was created by mistake, it can be deleted here as long as it has never governed a decision.
ui.policy.readonly: This is the policy being enforced. Editing happens in a separate, versioned flow.

ui.policy.slett_forklaring: If the policy was created by mistake, it can be deleted as long as it has never governed a decision. Drafts and attestations remain as history. The version numbers become available again — except a version that approvers attested against: it remains as inactive history so the attestation can still be read, and its number stays occupied.
ui.policy.slett_i_bruk: This policy has governed decisions and cannot be deleted — the audit trail references it. It can be retired, not deleted.
ui.policy.slett_runde_aapen: An activation round is open for this policy. Close the round first.
ui.policy.slett_tekst: The policy is deleted and the tenant has no active policy until a new one is activated. This cannot be undone.
ui.policy.slett_tekst_flere: Only this policy is deleted. The others that are active remain and continue to govern decisions. This cannot be undone.
ui.policy.slett_ukjent: This policy is no longer active — someone else may already have deleted it. Reload the page to see what applies now.

ui.policyadmin.gjenapne.tekst: The draft returns to an editable state and must be validated and attested again before it can be activated. Any open activation round is withdrawn.

ui.policyadmin.utfall.aktiv_peker_usynk: The active policy and its pointer are out of sync — the data must be repaired before activation.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.dokument_avvik: The draft does not match the policy it is being activated as ("meta.policy_id" or "meta.status"). The round is closed — the content is frozen, so a new draft is required.

ui.policyadmin.utfall.rebasering_kreves: The basis has changed — rebasing required.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.semantikk_endret: Engine semantics changed — open a new round.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.status_ikke_produk: The draft must have "meta.status": "produksjon" to be activated — the industry templates ship as "utkast". New drafts get the status set automatically; this draft is older and must be recreated.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.ukjent: Unknown outcome — check the state of the draft before continuing.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.utkast_ugyldig: The draft breaks a requirement that applies to every policy activated from now on — it was validated before the requirement existed. Fix the draft and validate again.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.versjon_i_bruk: The draft's version number is already registered, or is not newer than the active version. Increase "meta.versjon" in the draft and validate again.
ui.policyadmin.utfall.versjon_mangler: The draft has no valid version number in "meta.versjon" (the form 1.2.3). Fix it in the draft and validate again.
